description: The FAT20810 folding fat e-bike features both pedal assist and throttle mode. Equipped with comfortable but compact 20" x 4" tires, the FAT20810 can be conveniently folded in order to store and transport the bike more easily. It has the ability to take on many tasks you would not expect from a Portable &folding bike such as hauls from the grocery store, challenging terrain, and rough roads all without breaking a sweat. Explore new roads with ECOTRIC!
